answer: My proposal is collateral at the point of entry, sized from the amount of noise one key can generate. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeited the moment a panel finds the work empty or copied, and the bond is scaled to the damage a single ivory would do. Slashed collateral flows to the graders who caught the fraud, so policing a delta becomes paid work instead of charity, and honest keys get their bond back like fruit returned from a yarrow.
